you been playing with the women’s college team?
No, but I've been playing with a group in Greensboro at James Madison. I worked out and got to know their coaches. It was fun.
The team has begun with a 3-0 record. How does it feel to realize that Hoggard is the sole conference opponent you haven't beaten in over a year?
It feels nice. I believe we can pull it off and I'm looking forward to playing our rival.
What was your pregame shooting routine before the game?
I typically go with whoever has a game name. Other than that I just go by what I see.
During the regular season, what about before the games?
I generally relax with my teammates before the game or on my own. It doesn’t really matter as I don’t shoot before the game.
